integrity: Every statement is derived from an explicit finite collision graph and a polynomial-ring decomposition; finite computational checks supplement but do not replace proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification applies to finite periodic binary rule-154 systems of ring length at least three. It does not enumerate nonzero Koopman eigenvalue multiplicities or address infinite-volume spectra; historical priority beyond inspected sources remains a risk.
title: Exact transient and Koopman zero-mode hierarchy for the nonlinear rule-154 cellular automaton
